original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚奥贡州警方挫败摩托车与发电机盗窃案并逮捕嫌疑人
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 奥贡州警方在伊托里逮捕一名嫌疑人Adam Muhammed，并追回一辆摩托车和一台发电机。据称这些物品系其与在逃同伙所盗。警方称，一名驾车人于周日上午在Onigbedu–Itori路发现一辆无牌三轮车运载上述物品后报案。目前仅有一个来源报道此事，案件细节尚待进一步核实。

location.raw_text: Itori, headquarters of Ewekoro Local Government Area, Ogun State

key_facts.fact: 奥贡州警方逮捕嫌疑人Adam Muhammed并追回摩托车和发电机
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Ogun State Police Command has arrested a suspect, Adam Muhammed, and recovered a motorcycle and a generator

key_facts.fact: 据称被盗物品由嫌疑人与在逃同伙所盗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: allegedly stolen by him and his fleeing accomplice at Itori

key_facts.fact: 逮捕据称源于一名驾车人报案
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The arrest reportedly followed a tip-off from a motorist who spotted an unregistered tricycle conveying the items along the Onigbedu–Itori Road on Sunday morning

key_facts.fact: 事件时间为2026年10月25日上午7时30分左右
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At about 7:30 am on Sunday, October 25, 2026

uncertainties: 案件细节目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
